meta.name: Love Always
meta.description: A heartfelt tale of rediscovery about life and an unexpected second chance at love.

videos.title: Till Divorce Do Us Part
videos.overview: After 42 years of marriage, a divorce notice shatters a family celebration. A temple trip to mend the rift sends the couple tumbling into a cave… and a fate neither could imagine.

videos.title: Sixty Going On Twenty
videos.overview: Kannan and Manjula become 20 and are wanted as kidnappers. Sharing a hotel with their unsuspecting family, can they hide the truth when everyone is looking for them?

videos.title: The Years Between Us
videos.overview: Biryani, bike rides and renewed youth. Can magic be relied on to heal old wounds? Manjula longs for her estranged son, Vignesh, and someone from Kannan’s past reappears.

videos.title: Love, Lies and Law
videos.overview: Posing as Kunji and Thangamma, the couple join Deepika's law college and figure out how their magic works. New bonds blossom, but an old love complicates their second chance.

videos.title: The Past is Due
videos.overview: Guruji and Meera's past with Kannan resurfaces. Goons, debt and the mysterious property… what else is the family hiding?

videos.title: Whose Youth Is It Anyway?
videos.overview: The couple sense something is wrong with the magic. Meanwhile, Kannan lands an internship, Manjula grows close to Vignesh, and a bag of cash reignites their divorce battle.

videos.title: Logic Illa Magic
videos.overview: Gautham learns of Kannan's cancer. As Meera aids Guruji's ritual, Kannan and Manjula juggle their Sundarapuram function and a court case while dealing with faltering magic.

videos.title: Love Always
videos.overview: With their secret exposed, Kannan and Manjula face a choice that could change their lives forever. As the ritual approaches, can they find their way back to each other?
